nar.text: The weather was beautiful when the start was given at 8:00 a.m. The six cars were released in one-minute intervals onto the billiard-smooth circuit.

The Ballot of Goux crossed the finish line victorious at the end of 30 laps, after 3h35m09s.
Chassagne in the second Ballot followed almost six minutes behind while Wagner had to keep on driving as he was over one lap down after having to change five tires.
On the twelfth lap, Bordino set another track record with 6:54.1 at an average speed of 150.37 km/h, which remained unbeaten until the end of the race.
Two laps later, Goux, who had started two minutes behind Chassagne, overtook his teammate in front of the royal grandstand.
Jules Goux won the first Italian Grand Prix at an average speed of 144.736 km/h covering the 519 km in 3h 35m 09s.
